name: denoiser_name_projection_v7
method: Algebraic weight-space programming without training or gradients
hypothesis: The denoiser adds a learned noisy-coordinate embedding to atom identity embeddings in the same 128-dimensional stream. Components of ligand-name embeddings parallel to the three noisy-coordinate columns can act as name-dependent coordinate offsets at every denoising step. Remove those components from second-character digit columns, which standard protein heavy atoms do not use. This targets the denoiser's physical-coordinate stream, whereas the earlier v4 edit targeted reference-coordinate channels in the initial encoder. Preserve the input encoder and all coordinate weights.
